definitions.explanation: A prolonged fight or struggle, often organized and ideological in nature. Frequently used for labor disputes, political conflicts, and social movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{闘争|とうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The workers are continuing their struggle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧{闘争|とうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{党内|とうない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The power struggle within the party intensified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧{闘争|とうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧マルクス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{論|ろん}じた→論ずる：28402_ronzuru⟧。
examples.english: Marx argued that the history of humanity is the history of class struggle.

notes:
USAGE:
{闘争|とうそう} carries a strong, combative tone and is associated with organized movements, political activism, and ideological conflict. It is more intense than ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ and more purposeful than ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧{闘争|とうそう} (power struggle)
- ⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧{闘争|とうそう} (class struggle)
- ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧{闘争|とうそう} (labor dispute/struggle)
- {闘争|とうそう}{心|しん} (fighting spirit)
- {闘争|とうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧ (to wage a struggle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {闘争|とうそう}: organized struggle or conflict (political, ideological)
- ⟦{戦闘|せんとう}→戦闘：12639_sentou⟧: combat, battle (military)
- ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: dispute, quarrel (general conflict)
- ⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧: escape, flight (homophone, completely different meaning — note the different kanji)
